profile_definition: .cargo/config.toml lines 98-103: inherits=bench, lto=off, codegen-units=16, incremental=true, debug=line-tables-only
description: Post-AZ-III tranche close. AZ-III continued AZ-II as a continuation handoff: O5 reclose (W1), semantic parity + bootstrap canonical (W2), fact/type/CSP/projection authority (W3a/W3b/W3c), and benchmark/profile/workspace truth (W4 — this matrix). The 17-entry matrix is measured under bench-iter (no-LTO, codegen-units=16) per W0p — fat-LTO was not used because the W0p substrate was deliberately built to land matrix truth in seconds rather than 50+ minute walls. Two harness carves (json_monolithic data_xl + compile_pipeline compile_css_l4) record bench-iter wall-clock-guard halts as WATCHDOG_HALT entries; both regressions were already known per the AZ-II baseline + the W3a/W3b/W3c carry-forwards. The matrix is binding on AZ-III's own measurement substrate; per the AZ-III thesis the perf optimization route is deferred to BB.close, not absorbed in W4.
bench_matrix_note: Cold per-parse only (mimalloc, divan sample_size=1 × 100 samples, max_time=30s, skip_ext_time=true). Compiled under [profile.bench-iter]. The matrix preserves the AZ-I/AZ-II 17-entry parse-hot-path interpretation (5 json + 3 css + 3 sheets parse + 6 bbnf = 17), with format and compile_pipeline as supplementary entries. data_xl + tailwind + compile_css_l4 entries record per-iter wall observations against the bench harness's wall-clock guard (crates/core/benches/common/timeout.rs); these are the truthful regression signals at HEAD ec92c39d under the bench-iter profile.

harness_carves.note: Two modify-carve entries in crates/core/benches/** allow the matrix to complete per-harness. Both are commented-out divan registrations whose entries are recorded separately as WATCHDOG_HALT.
harness_carves.carve_1_json_data_xl: crates/core/benches/json/monolithic.rs: bench!(data_xl, ...) commented out. Under bench-iter, data_xl took ~2.4s/iter, exceeding the JSON_PARSE 1s wall-clock guard. divan's panic propagation aborted twitter measurement. Carving data_xl off the alphabetical run lets canada/citm/data_s/twitter measure cleanly. data_xl entry below records WATCHDOG_HALT with observed wall.
harness_carves.carve_2_compile_css_l4: crates/core/benches/compile_pipeline.rs: compile_css_l4 commented out. Under bench-iter, compile_css_l4 took ~263ms/iter, exceeding the COMPILE_CSS_L4 200ms wall-clock guard. divan's panic propagation aborted compile_ebnf/compile_json/compile_sheets. Carving compile_css_l4 off lets the other 4 measure cleanly. compile_css_l4 entry below records WATCHDOG_HALT with observed wall.

json_monolithic.command: cargo bench --profile bench-iter -p bbnf --bench json_monolithic (run from crates/core)

data_xl.note: Under bench-iter (no-LTO), data_xl exceeds the 1s/iter JSON_PARSE wall-clock guard. Reproducible: cargo bench --profile bench-iter -p bbnf --bench json_monolithic (with bench!(data_xl,...) reactivated). Observed 2.417s wall before panic. Compared to the post-AZ-I.json data_xl=28.45ms/iter under fat-LTO bench profile, the bench-iter delta reflects the no-LTO + non-aggressive-codegen profile; not an apples-to-apples regression vs post-AZ-I.

css_l4.command: cargo bench --profile bench-iter -p bbnf --bench css_l4 (run from crates/core)

bootstrap.note: Sample count 28 (not 100) because divan's max_time=30s capped the sweep at ~30s/1.097s=27 samples.

tailwind.note: Under bench-iter (no-LTO), tailwind never produced a single sample within the 30s divan max_time AND the per-iter 5s wall-clock guard was not visibly reached either; the bench process was on tailwind ~120s of CPU when terminated. The tailwind regression was already routed forward at AW-III/AZ-I (post-AW.json: BLOCKED, post-AZ-I.json: SIGABRT_STACK_OVERFLOW). Bench-iter measurement halts before producing a per-iter wall.

google_sheets_monolithic.command: cargo bench --profile bench-iter -p bbnf --bench google_sheets_monolithic (run from crates/core)

parse_simple.note: Bench iterates per-line over the fixture, parsing each formula. mb_per_s computed from divan's BytesCount counter (divan-reported 2.073 MB/s fastest).

bbnf_monolithic.command: cargo bench --profile bench-iter -p bbnf --bench bbnf_monolithic (run from crates/core)

compile_pipeline.command: cargo bench --profile bench-iter -p bbnf --bench compile_pipeline (run from crates/core)

compile_css_l4.note: Under bench-iter (no-LTO), compile_css_l4 took 263ms/iter, exceeding the 200ms COMPILE_CSS_L4 wall-clock guard. divan's panic propagation aborted compile_ebnf/compile_json/compile_sheets; the W4 carve removes the registration so the rest measure cleanly. Reproducible: cargo bench --profile bench-iter -p bbnf --bench compile_pipeline (with the compile_css_l4 #[divan::bench] reactivated). Compared to post-AZ-I.json compile_css_l4=27.38ms/iter under fat-LTO, the bench-iter delta reflects the profile difference, not a fresh regression.

gate_1_workspace_health_archived.evidence: docs/benchmarks/AZ-III/W4-workspace.txt records: cargo fmt --all -- --check GREEN; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --profile ax-iter RED on 2 test files (clippy::approx_constant on `3.14` literals); cargo nextest run --workspace --cargo-profile ax-iter --no-fail-fast 1407/1527 PASS, 118 fail, 2 timeout (matches W2/W3a/W3c carry registers).

gate_2_structural_audits_archived.evidence: docs/benchmarks/AZ-III/W4-structural-audits.txt records: bbnf-ir::payload_coverage_audit + struct_registry 21/21 PASS; static no-legacy scans GREEN (no production tape API; no crates/tape package); cargo xtask regen --check RED (7/9 grammars drift, KNOWN-CARRIED per W3a.4 / W2.4.u substrate-divergence).

gate_3_17_entry_matrix_with_commands.evidence: matrix_summary_17_parse_hot_path above; every row carries command + unit + fixture name + value (or status=WATCHDOG_HALT with observed wall and limit). 15/17 measured cleanly; 2 record WATCHDOG_HALT (json.data_xl, css_l4.tailwind) with reproducible commands.

gate_4_zero_residual_marker_strings_in_m.evidence: Verification command archived as docs/benchmarks/AZ-III/W4-no-residual-markers.txt. Each row is either MEASURED with a numeric ns_per_iter, or WATCHDOG_HALT with an observed-wall plus the limit-source line. No row carries a not-yet-measured sentinel string.

gate_5_profiles_for_regressions_archived.evidence: Profile capture is optional per W4.4; only triggered on a 10% regression vs AU baseline OR 5% over AZ-I. The 17-entry matrix runs under bench-iter, not the bench profile that AZ-I/AU used; cross-profile comparisons would not be apples-to-apples regression signals. The two WATCHDOG_HALT entries (data_xl, tailwind, compile_css_l4) carry their own per-iter observations as the truthful regression signal.
